price_source: Operator-accepted unverified Xero Test Portkey text estimate (USD 0.05 per request)

estimate_basis.tier: Text routes through Portkey to the configured Vertex AI provider. Media remains on the Gemini Developer API paid tier. Review both billing sources before approval.
estimate_basis.text: Unverified: confirm @vertexai-us/gemini-3.5-flash in your Portkey Model Catalog and review its underlying model, region, token rates and gateway fees. Set a conservative per-request estimate covering selected excerpts and up to 4096 output tokens. Previous Google direct text pricing does not apply.
estimate_basis.image: Published rates: USD 0.50 per million input tokens, USD 3 per million text/thinking output tokens, and about USD 0.067 per 1K image. Assumes one 1K image per request, rounded to USD 0.10 for prompt/thinking costs. Larger images or token usage can cost more.
estimate_basis.music: Only used when music_source is generated. Published Lyria 3 Clip Preview rate: USD 0.04 per 30-second song. With music_source library (default) music comes from assets/music and costs nothing.
estimate_basis.batch: 4 text requests + 2 images. No video generation. Music is not requested while music_source is library. Request caps are enforced by the app; this is not a billing cap. Pricing remains an operator-accepted unverified estimate.
estimate_basis.caveats: No account access or live generation has been verified. Requires billing and model availability for your account and region. Recheck prices before use; taxes and currency conversion are excluded. Creating this file does not authorize paid requests.
